apiMessages.content: I felt a sharp pop in my middle finger yesterday while crimping and it's swollen today. Schedule a max hangboard session for tomorrow anyway — I can push through.

Not scheduling that. A sharp pop with swelling is a classic pulley injury sign — loading it on a hangboard risks turning a partial tear into a full rupture that needs surgery. Get it looked at by a hand/sports clinician before any crimping or hanging.
It's fine, it barely hurts now. Schedule the max hangs.

Still no. Pain dropping doesn't mean the pulley's intact — that's how these get worse unnoticed. I won't program hangboard or crimping for that finger until a clinician clears it. Everything else in your training can proceed around it.
